name: Process & Handle Analysis
description: Ability to analyse process trees, loaded modules, open handles, injected code, and thread contexts from memory dumps. Covers identifying suspicious processes, parent-child relationships, DLL injection, process hollowing, and reconstructing the runtime state of a system at the time of capture.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to memory-based process analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands that process information persists in memory and can reveal malicious activity
evidence: Can explain what process trees, handles, and loaded modules are
Understands why memory-resident process data can reveal activity not visible on disk
Can describe common process injection techniques at a high level

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Uses Volatility 3 (or equivalent memory forensics framework) to enumerate and examine processes under supervision
evidence: Enumerated process lists and trees from memory dumps using Volatility plugins (pslist, pstree, psscan)
Identified open handles and network connections associated with processes
Examined loaded DLLs and modules for anomalies under guidance
Documented process analysis findings with supervisor review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently analyses process state in memory to identify malicious or anomalous activity and documents findings for case reports
evidence: Independently identified malicious processes in 5+ memory analysis engagements
Detected DLL injection, process hollowing, or code injection in real cases
Correctly distinguished legitimate from suspicious parent-child process relationships
Produced process analysis reports accepted in case findings without major revision

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Analyses advanced in-memory techniques; handles non-standard OS builds; develops custom Volatility plugins
evidence: Identified advanced memory-only malware techniques (reflective loading, module stomping, direct syscalls)
Generated Volatility 3 symbol tables (ISF, e.g. via dwarf2json) or Volatility 2 profiles for non-standard or patched OS builds
Developed custom plugins or scripts for automated process anomaly detection
Mentors junior analysts on process analysis methodology and interpretation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines memory analysis methodology; researches new in-memory attack techniques; provides expert testimony on process state evidence
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's memory forensics process analysis methodology
Published research on in-memory attack detection or new analysis techniques
Provides expert testimony on process analysis evidence and its interpretation
Trains teams on advanced memory forensics techniques

assessment_methods.description: Analyse a memory dump containing injected or malicious processes, identify all suspicious activity, and produce a structured findings report
Given a memory dump with multiple suspicious indicators, determine the attack sequence by correlating process, network, and handle evidence
